title: NovelAI text system prompt (novelai/text/system_prompt.json)
description: Optional sibling of novelai/text/spec/. When present, text is always prepended to every novelai-text generation. Omit the file to skip. Combined as system_prompt, memory, matching lorebook entries, then the spec story, joined by blank lines, and sent as the single /ai/generate input.

text.description: Instructions for how the model should write. Placed at the start of the assembled /ai/generate input.
